user.title: Sign in to DDPAI
user.description: Use the same login (email or phone) and password as the DDPAI app. Only cameras with a 4G link (SIM or 4G cloud box) appear in Home Assistant.

data_description.country: The country your DDPAI account is registered in.

reauth_confirm.title: DDPAI password changed
reauth_confirm.description: The saved password for {username} was refused. Enter the current one.

error.unknown_user: No DDPAI account with that login.
error.not_activated: This account's email address has not been activated yet.
error.locked: The account is locked. Unlock it in the DDPAI app first.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the DDPAI cloud.

abort.already_configured: This DDPAI account is already set up.
abort.no_4g_camera: No camera with a 4G link is bound to this account.
abort.wrong_account: That password belongs to a different account.

data.enable_media_browser: Show the cloud album in the media browser

data_description.scan_interval: How often state and position are read from the cloud.
data_description.enable_live_view: Adds a live camera per lens. Watching wakes the camera and uses its 4G data; it stops 15 seconds after the last viewer leaves.
data_description.tutk_license_key: The ThroughTek SDK license key of the DDPAI app, needed by the P2P library to open a live session.

rtsp.title: RTSP for an NVR

data_description.rtsp_mode: Only when triggered: live video while a trigger is active, a still standby picture the rest of the time. Always: live video whenever the NVR is connected.
data_description.rtsp_camera: Both: each camera gets its own address; while live they take turns.
data_description.rtsp_alerts: Only in 'only when triggered'. Events arrive with the poll, so live video starts up to one poll interval after the event.
data_description.rtsp_port: Not 8564 if the Proof Plus integration also serves RTSP on this box.

rtsp_trigger.name: RTSP: start live video

rtsp_stop.description: End every RTSP trigger now; the stream goes back to the standby picture.

read_settings.description: Read every remote setting from the dashcam (it must be online).
